author: Nerdstalgic
description:
For over a decade, the Marvel Cinematic Universe dominated Hollywood. Building toward massive crossover events like Avengers: Infinity War and Avengers: Endgame that redefined blockbuster storytelling.

But now, after 2 phases of directionless storytelling, Marvel is attempting something even bigger.   Avengers: Doomsday and Secret Wars will try to recreate that same magic in a completely different era. One filled with multiverse storylines, inconsistent releases, and growing audience fatigue.

So the question is…

Can Marvel actually deliver...or are they already in trouble?

#avengersdoomsday #spidermanbrandnewday #marvel #mcu #nerdstalgic
title: Can Secret Wars Save the MCU?
